cohort: Women who delivered at a single institution over 2 years who had an early screening HgbA1c test performed at <=20 weeks of gestation and no known preexisting diabetes mellitus or HgbA1c values >=6.5%
finding: Women with an early screening HgbA1c value of 5.7-6.4% have a significantly higher risk of developing gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) compared to women with normal HgbA1c values.
